purpose: Instrumented single-lane release comparison of final original submission deadline margin and ACK receive-to-staging age
kernel: Linux 6.8.0-149-generic #149-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Oct 23 13:21:10 UTC 2026 x86_64
cpu_model: model name	: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Gold 6138 CPU @ 2.00GHz
instrumentation: One histogram sample per frame's final successful original submission using its existing actual-send time; one fresh I/O-clock read and histogram sample per staged ACK-report chunk using original socket receive time. Fourteen additional worker-only counters. No per-frame storage or policy change.
limitations: Diagnostic overhead is included; no claim of a production speedup.
Aggregate histograms do not join an expired frame to its final submission time or prove remote delivery.
ACK staging age excludes remote ACK generation, pre-read socket queueing and missing ACK coverage; chunks are not packet/frame counts.
One twenty-second A/B/A sequence; eight workers/TAP queues and one TX lane.
No local builds, kernel tests or Git packing overlap load.
Original runtime integration not rerun for this diagnostic.
